name: ABC Sunshine and the Midnight Daycare
source:
A private investigator is hired by a mother to uncover the real reason behind the closure of a daycare/school after she reports that something happened to her child. The business claims it couldn't afford maintenance due to the rising costs of carebots.

During his investigation, the detective becomes trapped inside the facility, waiting for help to arrive. Meanwhile, Sunshine and her friends try to keep him entertained, but one of them might be the suspect behind the tragedy. The detective must uncover the truth while navigating the eerie atmosphere of the abandoned daycare.

[From [url=https://tales-from-the-creepy.itch.io/abc-sunshineandthemidnightdaycare]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位母亲在报告她的孩子发生了什么事后，聘请了一名私家侦探来揭露日托/学校关闭的真正原因。该公司声称，由于护理机器人成本不断上涨，它无力承担维护费用。

在调查过程中，侦探被困在设施内，等待救援到来。与此同时，阳光和她的朋友们试图让他开心，但其中一个人可能是这场悲剧背后的嫌疑人。侦探必须在废弃日托所的怪异气氛中揭开真相。

[来自[url=https://tales-from-the-creepy.itch.io/abc-sunshineandthemidnightdaycare]Itch.io[/url]]
